This my rice plot, small one, less than one hectare. I plant rice every year same way my father taught me. Last year I put small fertilizer, the urea one, because rice need it to grow well — without it the grain stay empty. I cannot buy plenty, money no reach, so I buy one bag and spread am for this plot. I use my own seed I keep from last harvest, no money for new seed from the market. My wife and children help me, we work together, and when time to transplant and harvest come I call two-three people from the village to help me small.
